content.title: Happy Easter Sunday 2026: Images, Quotes, Wishes, Messages, Images,  Cards, Greetings, Pictures and GIFs
content.text: Easter Sunday marks a time of hope and renewal, celebrating Jesus Christ's resurrection. This central Christian event symbolizes victory over sin and death, offering believers eternal life. Families gather for services and feasts, embracing customs that blend ancient rites with Christian meaning, spreading messages of forgiveness and new beginnings.Easter Sunday brings a new wave of hope and renewal after a season of reflection during Lent. Families gather, churches fill with joyful hymns, and the promise of spring symbolises the resurrection story at Christianity's heart.Whether you're sharing moments with loved ones or reaching out virtually, this day calls for simple expressions of faith, love, and new beginnings. It's that special time when chocolate eggs, blooming lilies, and heartfelt greetings remind us of life's brighter side amid everyday hustle.Why is Easter celebrated?Easter is celebrated by Christians worldwide as the most joyful holiday, marking Jesus Christ's resurrection from the dead three days after his crucifixion on Good Friday.This event, central to Christianity, symbolises victory over sin and death, offering believers hope for life. According to the Bible, women visiting Jesus' tomb found it empty, with an angel announcing, "He is not here; he has risen" (Matthew 28:6).The celebration dates back to the early church, formalised by the 4th century at the Council of Nicaea in 325 AD, which set Easter on the first Sunday after the first full moon following the spring equinox, happening usually late March or April. In 2026, it falls on April 5.Families gather for church services with hymns and sermons, then share feasts with eggs which are symbols of new life, lambs, representing Jesus, and chocolate treats. Kids hunt for Easter eggs, a fun representation to the tomb's stone rolled away. Customs are a combination of ancient pagan spring rites with Christian meaning, like renewal and rebirth.Beyond religion, Easter spreads messages of forgiveness, new beginnings, and community, reminding us that even in tough times, hope rises. It's about love conquering all, celebrated with bunnies, baskets, and heartfelt "He is risen!" greetings.Happy Easter Sunday 2026: Images, Quotes, Wishes, Messages, Cards, Greetings, Pictures and GIFsHere are some wishes, messages and quotes to share with your loved ones on Easter 2026Biblical Easter Quotes to Share with Family, Friends and Loved Ones"He is not here; he has risen, just as he said." – Matthew 28:6 (Bible)"Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life.'" – John 11:25 (Bible)"Our Lord has written the promise of the resurrection, not in books alone, but in every leaf in springtime." – Martin Luther"Do not abandon yourselves to despair.
